title: athyrium deltoidofrons var. latisectum
intro: Athyrium deltoidofrons var. latisectum, commonly known as Lady fern, is a type of plant belonging to the Athyrium genus. This plant is said to have various health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lady fern include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, astringent, and antiseptic, which can help in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Lady fern include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
